# Claude Cowork Guide

> Independent, community-maintained guide to Claude Cowork. Not affiliated with Anthropic.

## Verified guide facts

- Canonical URL: https://cowork.bruniaux.com/
- Source repository: https://github.com/FlorianBruniaux/claude-cowork-guide
- Guide version: 1.12.0
- Product facts last checked: 2026-09-04
- License: CC BY-SA 4.0
- Languages: English and French
- Corpus: 29 bilingual workflows and 70 numbered prompts

## Product scope

Cowork availability and capabilities depend on plan and surface. Anthropic currently documents eligible paid plans, desktop support for macOS and Windows, Linux Desktop in beta, web and mobile access in beta, connectors, and code execution in an isolated environment. Local files, browser access, and computer use have surface-specific conditions. Computer use remains a research preview.

Primary sources:
- https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13345190-get-started-with-claude-cowork
- https://support.claude.com/en/articles/15520349-use-claude-cowork-on-web-desktop-and-mobile
- https://support.claude.com/en/articles/10065433-install-claude-desktop
- https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14479288-claude-cowork-architecture-overview
- https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14128542-let-claude-use-your-computer-in-cowork

## Provenance

Use the public site for canonical pages and the GitHub repository for source history, issues, and contributions. The guide is free; Claude Cowork itself is not described as free.
